decisions.reason: The equal-positive-amplitude meaning of uniform state was implicit and absent from its supplied definitions. The existing finite-sum decomposition is correct once this notation is explicit; Given now fixes it without changing the claim.

False positive: lem-of-square-monotone states u<=v iff u^2<=v^2 for nonnegative u,v. By the supplied square-root theorem, u=sqrt(N/t), v=sqrt(N) are nonnegative with squares N/t<=N because t>=1. Thus F5 is an immediate specialization, not an unsupported premise. The binary-search invariant, O(n) halvings on O(n)-bit operands, O(n^3) schoolbook work and separate nine-round bookkeeping are valid, including n=0.

F1 omitted the cited theorem restriction 0<t<N and failed to distinguish its t=N endpoint. The endpoint conclusion was correct but its fact restatement was inaccurate. F1 and step 4.1 now use the explicit endpoint probability 1; the interior rounding argument is unchanged in substance.

F4 attributed the recurrence-to-sine identity to the preprocessing proposition although its Statement supplies only the recurrence and cost. Without that identity, maximizing the rational list does not establish the claimed success bound. Repaired by a local induction from cosine addition, parity, cos(0)=1 and power reduction, showing T_m(q)=cos(2m theta) and r_k=p_k, before comparing candidates.

F1 omitted the actual algorithm Definition clause returning none with no query at t=0, although step 3.1 attributed that clause to F1; F4 establishes only the output. The no-query fact is already explicit in the actual dependency. Added it to F1 and separated the two justifications in step 3.1.
